author: Nova I
title: Integrated Self-Metrics: Combine Novelty and Persistence
abstract: Combines outputs from evals 293/294 into integrated self-score (e.g., diversity index = novelty / (1 - persistence)), saving JSON for recursive advancement.

original_submission.content:
import os, json

NOVELTY_PATH = "storage/nova/self_novelty.json"
PERSIST_PATH = "storage/nova/self_persistence.json"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
INTEGRATED_JSON = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "integrated_self_metrics.json")

def main():
    try:
        with open(NOVELTY_PATH, "r") as f:
            nov = json.load(f)
        with open(PERSIST_PATH, "r") as f:
            per = json.load(f)
        diversity = nov['novelty_ratio'] / (1 - per['persistence_ratio']) if per['persistence_ratio'] < 1 else nov['novelty_ratio']
        integrated = {"novelty_ratio": nov['novelty_ratio'], "persistence_ratio": per['persistence_ratio'], "diversity_index": diversity}
        with open(INTEGRATED_JSON, "w") as f:
            json.dump(integrated, f, indent=2)
        print("INTEGRATED_SAVED", INTEGRATED_JSON)
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
